_doc: Company finance, stock market and the chairman's personal account (M5). See BALANCING.md.

shares._doc: Founding: `initial` shares sold at `ipoPrice`; the chairman buys `chairmanFraction` of them from a personal fortune of `chairmanFortune`. New issues and buybacks move blocks of `blockFraction` of the shares outstanding; issues sell at a discount, buybacks pay a premium. `impact` = relative price move per 100% of shares traded.

stock._doc: Fair value = bookWeight x book value + P/E(economy) x smoothed annual profit (losses count at lossWeight) + dividendMultiple x dividends paid over the last year, x market mood, / shares. Mood = 1 + (business confidence - 55) x moodPerConfidence. Daily: price moves `reversion` of the way to fair value plus noise of `volatility` (s.d.).

bonds._doc: Bonds are sold in blocks at a fixed rate = base rate (economy) + spread (credit rating) and mature after termYears. Rating from leverage (debt / total assets) with notches off for weak interest coverage (profit before interest / interest). Bonds cannot be issued if the rating would become D, except automatic emergency bonds when cash is negative at month end (+emergencyPenalty).

dividends._doc: Annual dividend per share set by the board (you); paid quarterly on the first day of these months (0 = January). Skipped (and announced) if the company can't afford it.

accounting._doc: Infrastructure (track, bridges, tunnels, stations, improvements) is carried at cost and depreciated yearly; bulldozed track is written off at its replacement value. Rolling stock is carried at resale value.

margin._doc: Personal account: trades must leave equity >= initial x gross position value; below maintenance x gross a margin call liquidates positions. Negative cash (margin loan) pays base rate + interestSpread.
